newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola dips on CBOT but underpinned by exports.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola dips on CBOT but underpinned by exports.

text.p: WCE canola futures traded lower in brisk trading at midsession but losses were limited by export buying, traders said.
"We've got good exporter buying met by Cargill and fund selling," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread at $3.90. Funds sold more than 500 January. Volume was heavy, sources said.
Japan bought 3,000 tonnes overnight and Europe was rumoured to be seeking canola, sources said.
November canola futures fell $1.50 to $438.40 at 1110 CDT and January was down $0.50 to $442.50. October flax fell $1 to $393.50, November down $0.50 to $370 in light trade.
Feed peas did not trade at midsession.
October feed wheat lost $1.80 to $207.40 and December slipped $1.20 to $194.30 on commission and local selling and Alberta Wheat Pool selling the Oct-Mar spread at $14.50, traders said.
November western barley lost $1.80 to $152 and February was down $1.80 to $156 with XCan and Benson Quinn selling.
Cargill bought October oats down US$2.20 to US$134.80.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
